detail: No French state honour (Légion d'honneur, Ordre national du Mérite) could be confirmed against a primary source (Légifrance/JORF decree or the official Légion d'honneur database). A claim that Zemmour was named Chevalier de la Légion d'honneur in the 1 January 2013 civil promotion circulates online but traces only to a partisan blog (dreuz.info) and was not corroborated by any primary decree or mainstream outlet; it is therefore recorded as UNVERIFIED, not as fact. No Ordre national du Mérite and no journalism award were found.
